verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud decisioning SaaS platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. The pack documents an llms.txt docs index for AI agents, a public OpenAPI document, and marketing about 'agentic automation'. These are adjacent machine-readable surfaces and developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
